purpose: Help a person resume meaningful work after interruption with less remembering and sequencing.
principles: Preserve continuity without overriding user agency.
Make direct workspace intent legible in compact navigation.
system: A compact workspace navigation control supports named direct-intent routes and returns from its navigator modal to the active workspace route.
build: A focused navigation accessibility repair gives every compact direct-intent control an accessible name while preserving the active workspace route after the navigator closes.
evidence: Local verification on the exact revision includes focused navigation tests, static checks, a full test suite, an independent code review, and a 375px responsive inspection confirming named compact navigation controls and return to an active workspace route.
boundaries: The candidate is local-only and unpublished until explicit owner copy approval. No MSI or Tower verification is represented by this candidate. The invalid-route fallback behavior remains unproven by this evidence. It does not establish release, deployment, production availability, or broader Brain Bridge availability.
